events.name: The Menzingers: Everything I Ever Saw North American Tour
Hannah Wicklund at Bug Jar
events.info: Hannah Wicklund is a South-Carolina-born rock musician who has spent more than two decades connecting people over her raw vocal power, world class guitar playing and awe inspiring live performances. Blending the raw power of rock n' roll, soul and psychedelic, Wicklund creates music for those seeking authenticity, human connection and creative freedom in an increasingly disconnected world. Her career began as a child performing with her band on the beaches of Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. After an early graduation from High School, she hit the road and hasn't looked back since performing in over 20 countries from intimate clubs to some of the world's biggest stages. Over the years, Wicklund has earned praise from Rolling Stone, Guitar World and Billboard. Her commanding live performances, musicianship and fiercely independent creative vision have helped build a devoted audience spanning generations and walks of life. Now, Hannah enters her most ambitious chapter yet with her fourth studio album, War on Women; Calling All Good Men (Out 8/28/26). Across 13 tracks, she moves fearlessly through rock, soul, blues, folk, gospel, psychedilia and pop, creating a record that can be both beauty and beast. Born from her experiences navigating power, betrayal, love and the expectations placed upon women to make themselves smaller, the album is deeply personal and a call-to-arms for change, and a tale of heartbreak in strange circumstances. Laying bare the obstacles Hannah overcame to take back control of her career, and offers hope for the future.
